_comment: Deployment configuration â€” externalizes what used to be hardcoded in backend/pipeline_worker.py and backend/main.py, closing PS #1 objective 12 (updated PDF): 'adaptable and configurable for deployment across multiple educational environments.' Deploying to a new room means editing this file, not the codebase. image_points/seats are pixel coordinates from calibration/calibrate_tool.py; plane_points are the corresponding real-world/desk-plane coordinates from the same calibration session.

cameras._comment: Accuracy audit (2026-08-22): NOT simulated in the sense the other _SIMULATED cameras are (those reuse cam04's footage through a fake homography) -- this points at two REAL, independently-filmed, ground-truth-labeled videos (their own filenames state the real outcome: 'Candidate was found using a mobile phone in the examination hall'). Playlist cycles 01 then 02, then wraps -- exercising the multi-video-playlist feature (CameraConfig.playlist) instead of looping one clip forever. Calibration here is deliberately coarse (one wide seat_20 zone spanning almost the whole frame, not a precise per-seat homography) because no real measured seating chart exists for this specific room -- exactly the honest caveat this project already applies to every illustrative calibration. It's enough to prove the actual point: confirmed object detection on real footage genuinely produces a genuine, well-justified, non-flooding alert.

SIMULATED â€” Hall B has no real second camera either; this reuses the same single video source this whole project has (data/test_videos/04) through yet another homography, purely to give the multi-hall navigation shell (Phase 1) and analyst wall (Phase 2) real multiple halls to scope and group by. Deliberately reuses the same proven image_points region as cam04_illustrative (known to have real tracked people in this footage) rather than an unverified guess elsewhere in frame, which produced zero tracked seats when tried. New real footage added 2026-08-23 (user-supplied, 'CAMERA5_2026_08_11_14_58_17.mkv', ~3 hours, real workstation/computer-lab CCTV with numbered desk placards 04/05/07/08/09/10 physically visible in frame). Identity homography (image_points == plane_points, the full frame) so seat positions are given directly in pixel space with no projective distortion to reason about -- same simplification cam_ground_truth uses. Seat positions are visual estimates from a single sampled frame, not a measured calibration (calibrate_tool.py) -- same honest caveat as every other illustrative camera in this file. (not seat_4/seat_7/etc.) specifically to avoid colliding with the existing seat_4/seat_7/seat_8/seat_9/seat_10 already assigned to Hall A/B's cameras above -- this is a genuinely separate room (Hall D), not a replacement for anything.
